short_description: Code Alkonost is a first-person dark fantasy where Slavic myths come alive. Explore a haunted world, face spirits of the underworld, and meet creatures like Baba Yaga and Leshy. Experience a unique blend of horror, mythology, and atmospheric storytelling.
steam_categories: Single-player; Steam Achievements; Steam Cloud; Remote Play Together; Family Sharing
